pages.title: Making Tartarite
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Adamantine + 1 Atlarus = 1 Tartarite

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 3782 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 7.$(br)Mining efficiency: 12.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 9.0.$(br)Enchantability: 14.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 5, chestplate 7, leggings 6, boots 5.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 6.0.$(br)Enchantability: 14.$(br)Extra full-set health: 10.0 HP.

pages.title: Paragon Absorption
pages.text: Use the Paragon cross recipe to absorb a suitable material. The top metal block selects it. Tartarite armor counts twice for eligible absorbed armor powers, up to an effective level of four.
